cohort: The study included 40 women who presented to the Mansoura Nephrology and Dialysis Unit with Pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (PRAKI) over two years.
finding: Pregnancy-related acute kidney injury (PRAKI) was reported in about 1% of women presenting to obstetrics, with preeclampsia and obstetric hemorrhage identified as the commonest causes, leading to 22.5% maternal mortality and unfavorable fetal events in 60% of pregnancies.
followup_time: 3 months after hospital discharge for renal outcome, and until the end of pregnancy for maternal and fetal outcomes
